study type: Pilot quasi-experimental intervention study with a mixed-methods approach
exposure: brief, intensive CBT-based anxiety prevention intervention programme
outcome: acquisition and application of CBT-based programme skills
cohort: The study included a sample of 21 farmworkers' children aged 9-14 years living in disadvantaged semi-rural communities of the Western Cape, South Africa.
finding: The brief, intensive CBT-based anxiety prevention programme showed positive effects, including a trend reflecting a reduction of self-reported anxiety levels and qualitative support for the acquisition and application of the programme skills.
